**Config change** — `/adapt/ops/deepseek-harness/settings.yaml` (`llm-pi-ai.providers.openrouter.models`):
- **18 new entries** added from the live OpenRouter `/api/v1/models` listing (21 zero-priced models found): `stealth/ox-alpha`, `dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free`, `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free`, `thinkingmachines/inkling:free` + `inkling-small:free`, `poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free` + `laguna-xs-2.1:free`, `cohere/north-mini-code:free`, `z-ai/glm-5.2:free`, `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free`, `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free`, `minimax/minimax-m3:free`, `google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free`, `google/lyria-3-pro-preview` + `lyria-3-clip-preview` (text-input music previews), `minimax/minimax-m2.7:free`, `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free`, and `openrouter/free` ("OpenRouter Free Auto" alongside the existing `openrouter/auto`).
- Context windows taken from the live listing (up to 1M); conservative `8192` output caps; audio/video inputs aren't declarable under this catalog, so only `text`/`image` inputs are offered.
- **Refreshed drifted facts** on the two pre-existing free entries: `liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free` 32000→65536 ctx, `google/gemma-4-31b-it:free` 128000→262144 ctx (+image).
- **Deliberate omission**: `nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free` — previously found unserviceable through OpenRouter (per your standing context); commented in-file.

**No restart**: the settings document hot-reloads (`applies: live`). I verified against the *running* web host via `settings.describe` — revision 3, all 30 OpenRouter models including the new free entries present. The Models page in this GUI will show them after a refresh; no Web artifact rebuild was needed. Ops entry logged in `operations_history.md`.
